item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Thu Aug 20, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.description:
Guests are invited to stop by and learn a full skincare routine at dedicated stations: cleanse, treat, and moisturize, step by step. They can wash their face alongside the team and feel the difference, or simply watch and take notes — either way, they’ll leave knowing exactly what their skin needs and how to layer products the right way. item.description:
Price: Adult $10, Senior/Full Time Student $5 \(Plus a $2 p er ticket service Charge Online\)
Ticket Info:
Sponsor: Marin Center
Link: http://www.marincounty.org/depts/cu
The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. The cost is $10 adults and $5 seniors and students. No reservations are required. Groups of ten or more can arrange a private docent tour by calling the Visitor Services Office at \(415\) 473-3762.

item.description:
HenHouse Tasting Room West Coast Riddims Tour
Friday - Aug. 21, 2026 \* 5:00 PM
🎸🌊 Sweet Sixx hits the road for the \*\*West Coast Riddims Tour 2026\*\*, a musical journey from Baja California to Southern Oregon and back along the California coast.
Find us at pop-up street performances, busking, breweries, wineries, farmers' markets, and community events while connecting with friends, fans, and fellow musicians.
Our mission is simple:
Busk. Connect with people. Tell our Baja stories through music. Follow the journey, updates, and surprise performances at http://www.sweetsixx.com.
Along the way, we'll be filming content, building future tour relationships, and sharing our original West Coast Reggae Fusion in some of California's most beautiful coastal communities. http://www.sweetsixx.com.
\*\*Route:\*\*
La Salina → San Diego → Santa Barbara → Santa Cruz → Santa Rosa → Arcata → Eureka → Grants Pass \(Aug. 16–19\) → Crescent City → Fort Bragg → Mendocino → Santa Cruz → Santa Barb

item.title: JourneyDay Music — Fri Aug 21, 5:00 PM — Merryvale Vineyards
item.description:
JourneyDay has been entertaining audiences with his signature "one man band" sound for over 10 years. Covering hits spanning multiple decades, he is a crowd pleaser for all ages. JourneyDay's sound combines intricate guitar leads, chest thumping bass and vocal percussion and soulful vocals to provide a one of a kind musical experience. Whether performing in an intimate dinner setting, providing background music or getting the crowd up and on their feet, JourneyDay can do it all. You can also find him performing with his award winning A Cappella group Take flight and Nationally touring group, Ball in the House.

item.description:

item.title: Fall Field Trip to the Wild Honeybee Populations — Sat Aug 22, 9:30 AM — Galbreath Wildlands Preserve
item.description:

Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal.
